runtime.limitation: Slurm elapsed includes batch setup; runner elapsed begins before preflight. Queue and collection/transfer excluded. Accounting can be unavailable; no timestamp inference.

science.main_comparison: Established scientific tolerances; not bitwise equality for the block family.

zero_Domain_rank_inputs.scope: Map exact matched gradient input records to the actual resident block rank. Zero Domain status is inferred from that rank's gradient-check counter increment at the same transaction/layer, not its rank number.

decision: Sampled interior scalar reuse gate passes through 256 ranks. Proceed to a bounded fused block primitive-producer prototype with exact-phase halo/alias validation and direct local consumers. Preserve fusion and measure all new preparation/communication costs before production replacement.
limitations: All input matches are mapped owner interiors at 16 selected call/layer combinations; destination halo freshness, unsampled layers/calls and boundary aliases remain unproved.
Flux, PV, physics, Bernoulli and Exner block residency is not established by this scalar probe.
Budgets sum rank-local structural observations; they are not a synchronized mesh census, executed traffic, time-weighted work or speedup.
Hypothetical upstream ownership is conditional and excludes its own production/communication costs.
Zero-Domain-rank input correctness does not establish useful computation, load balance or >=640-rank efficiency.
Binary/checkpoint/VTK payloads omitted; cluster-computed hashes and numerical reports verified, not rerun.
